Antibodies B42.20 Community - compatibility fix 0.2.3

Target: Project Zomboid 42.20.3

Changes:
- Corrected Build 42 percent placeholders that displayed a stray "$s" suffix.
- Disabled legacy translation files so they cannot override the JSON translations.
- Added Build 42.20 JSON translations for the UI and sandbox settings.
- Restored translated labels so the diagnosis window no longer displays long raw keys.
- Corrected five shared timed-action require paths in client and server entry points.
- Corrected the ISPanel require path.
- Corrected the Build 42 paths for ISCharacterProtection, ISCharacterInfoWindow, and ISHealthPanel.

Workshop Mod ID: AntibodiesB4220ServerFix

The code and sandbox option namespaces remain compatible with the original mod,
but this package has a unique loader ID to avoid ambiguous duplicate-ID selection.
Disable the original Workshop package before enabling this fix.

Original project: https://github.com/lonegamedev/pz_mod_antibodies
Original author: lonegamedev
